headline: As of 2026-09-22: 77,248 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 5 of 50 states, D+50.2 registration lean.
bullets: 77,248 early/mail ballots cast so far across 5 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+50.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (65,527), North Carolina (7,445), Pennsylvania (3,386).
